name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Refrigeration attacks hit EU supermarkets; Binance theft largest on record
state: Cyberattacks on 2 Nov caused refrigeration failures at more than 100 shops across several EU countries, forcing stock to be discarded; Belgium opened a criminal investigation (Al Jazeera). Binance said on 3 Nov that North Korea-linked hackers spent months inside its systems, gaining access via a fake job interview, before the $6.3bn theft (Fortune).
for_you: Follow NCSC advice on phishing and fake recruiter approaches; change passwords if a service you use reports a breach.
rubric_hit: Attacks disrupting large companies across countries = Watch

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Who's attacking Europe's supermarket freezers?

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
